business_summary: CNS Co.,Ltd., together with its subsidiaries, provides system engineering services in Japan. It offers consulting services, including DX consulting, technology consulting, business consulting; System Integration services, such as cloud environment setup, infrastructure environment construction, application development, modernization, data utilization and analysis, SAS implementation support, service now implementation support; DX literacy education and human resource development support; and U-Way oracle cloud infrastructure, oracle cloud VMware solution, lite OCI model, and migration to SAS Viya. CNS Co.,Ltd. was incorporated in 1985 and is headquartered in Tokyo, Japan.
